messages.subject: Errors using "spatialDetectionHistory" function
parts:
Hello there,

I am facing some issues with the function "spatialDetectionHistory", which I am not finding a solution, and I would appreciate very much any help. 

The first issue I have faced and solved in the past, when camtrapR was still in one of the first versions. I am usnig the latest version (2.2.0) now, and managed to solve this issue in similar way. However, when I used the old version, after this fix I ran "spatialDetectionHistory" and it all worked fine. Using both versions, the error read the following:

"Error: there is a mismatch between station IDs in CTtable and rownames in camOp (length differs)"

Looking at the vignette of the latest camtrapR version, I understand that the function "cameraOperation" now attaches a suffix in the Station name (CAM), if I use two camer-traps per station, as in my case. So I created a new column in both the recordTableIndividual and the CTtable, to match the rownames of the camOp table. I attached prints of the original tables and the fixes.

head(amos2019) # CTtable before fixing the first error
head(amos2019) # CTtable after fixing the first error and adding new column "Station_Cam"

The first error above is solved, but now, I run into the following error without being able to go around:

"Error in make.capthist(captures = sdh2, traps = secr.traps, fmt = "trapID", :
failed to match some capture locations to detector sites

1. spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = recTabInd, species = "Jaguatirica",
camOp = amos2019_Prob, CTtable = amos2019, output = "count",
stationCol = "Station_Cam", speciesCol = "Species", Xcol = "Utm_X",
Ycol = "Utm_Y", individualCol = "Individual", individualCovariateCols = "Sex", 

2. make.capthist(captures = sdh2, traps = secr.traps, fmt = "trapID",
noccasions = noccasions, bysession = TRUE)

3. stop("failed to match some capture locations ", "to detector sites") "

My codes are:

amos2019_Prob <- cameraOperation(CTtable = amos2019,
stationCol = "Station",
cameraCol = "Camera",
setupCol = "data_inicial",
retrievalCol = "data_final",
writecsv = T,
hasProblems = TRUE,
byCamera = TRUE,
#allCamsOn = FALSE,
outDir = "C:/CameraTrapPicSF/2019_Amostragem",
dateFormat = "%d/%m/%Y"
)

amos2019_Prob[1:6,1:6]


recTabInd <- recordTableIndividual(inDir = "C:/Jaguatirica",
hasStationFolders = FALSE,
IDfrom = "directory",
cameraID = "filename",
camerasIndependent = FALSE,
minDeltaTime = 60,
deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
timeZone = "America/Campo_Grande",
stationCol = "Station",
writecsv = TRUE,
outDir = "C:/CameraTrapPicSF/stragemFinal_2019",
removeDuplicateRecords = TRUE,
returnFileNamesMissingTags = TRUE
)

head(recTabInd ) # before fixing the first error


head(recTabInd ) # after fixing the first error and adding new column "Station_Cam"


JaguaSDH <- spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = recTabInd,
species = "Jaguatirica", 
camOp = amos2019_Prob, 
CTtable = amos2019, 
output = "count", 
stationCol = "Station_Cam",
speciesCol = "Species",
Xcol = "Utm_X",
Ycol = "Utm_Y",
individualCol = "Individual",
individualCovariateCols = "Sex",
recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
occasionLength = 1,
day1 = "station", 
includeEffort = TRUE,
scaleEffort = FALSE,
binaryEffort = FALSE,
timeZone = "America/Campo_Grande",
makeRMarkInput = FALSE
)

I appreciate any help!
Cheers,
Henrique

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Errors using "spatialDetectionHistory" function
parts:
Hi,
normally such workarounds should not be necessary. For spatialDetectionHistory(), I think one needs to set byCamera= FALSE in cameraOperation. Then there will be no "CAM" prefix in the station names, no need for manual edits and no mismatch in station IDs

If that is not the case, would you be able to share a short reproducible example please?
Thank you,
Jürgen

messages.author: e2a9c233608d47ac
messages.subject: Re: Errors using "spatialDetectionHistory" function
parts:
Hi Jurgen,

First, thank you for your reply and apologies for not answering your post before.
I actually managed to workaround that problem, but I didn't understand why in spatialDetectionHistory() I would need to set byCamera=FALSE in cameraOperation. The idea of setting byCamera=TRUE was to be able to check whenever one of the cameras in the pair would fail, which would affect detection parameters, because I am inputing effort in my secr models. So, if one station (two cameras) is entirely operational, the effort is 1, if one of the cameras of the station is off, effort is 0.5, and if none are operational, then effort is 0. This coding (0, 0.5, 1) as input for the secr modelling, in the trap file with header 'usage'.

Thanks again for your attention.
Henrique

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Errors using "spatialDetectionHistory" function
parts:
Hi,
in cameraOperation(),
byCamera = T means that each camera is treated as an individual "station". In most scenarios that doesn't make much sense since multiple cameras at a station are usually near each other.

byCamera = F means that both cameras are combined into a single "station". This is normally the preferred choice. It also allows accounting for incomplete effort at individual cameras. If camerasIndependent = TRUE (cameras facing different directions), then effort per (full) day can be 2, 1, or 0 (depending on whether both, one, or no camera was active). If camerasIndependent = FALSE (paired cameras observing the same spot), then corresponding effort would be 1,1, or 0 (with two, one, and no camera active).

The problem is that spatialDetectionHistory expects a camera trap table with one row per station though, not two (for the coordinates at each station). So one can't just use the same camera trap table as for cameraOperation and instead aggregate by station first. Not ideal, I'll try to find a solution for that.

See below for a worked example. Two stations, one with two cameras and the other with one camera, and some cameras malfunctioning. The example works with byCamera = FALSE and accounts for incomplete effort.

data("camtraps")

# simulate camera trap table with two cameras at "StationA" and one camera at "StationB"
camtraps$Station <- c("StationA", "StationA", "StationB")
camtraps$camera <- c("cam1", "cam2", "cam3")
camtraps$Problem1_from[2] <- "01/05/2009"   # StationA/cam2 malfunctioned for a few days
camtraps$Problem1_to[2] <- "10/05/2009"


camop_problem <- cameraOperation(CTtable      = camtraps,
                                 stationCol   = "Station",
                                 cameraCol    = "camera",
                                 byCamera     = F,
                                 allCamsOn    = F,
                                 camerasIndependent = T,
                                 setupCol     = "Setup_date",
                                 retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date",
                                 writecsv     = FALSE,
                                 hasProblems  = T,
                                 dateFormat   = "dmy"
)

camtrapR:::camopPlot(camop_problem)



data(recordTableIndividualSample)
recordTableIndividualSample <- recordTableIndividualSample[recordTableIndividualSample$Station != "StationC",]


# aggregate camera trap table with multiple entries per station to one row per station
# only relevant for coordinates, which are averaged (= midpoint between cameras)
camtraps_by_station <- aggregate(camtraps[, c("utm_y", "utm_x")], by = list(camtraps$Station), FUN = mean)
colnames(camtraps_by_station)[1] <- "Station"


sdh <- spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = recordTableIndividualSample,
                               species               = "LeopardCat",
                               camOp                 = camop_problem,
                               CTtable               = camtraps_by_station,   # instead of camtraps
                               output                = "binary",
                               stationCol            = "Station",
                               speciesCol            = "Species",
                               Xcol                  = "utm_x",
                               Ycol                  = "utm_y",
                               individualCol         = "Individual",
                               recordDateTimeCol     = "DateTimeOriginal",
                               recordDateTimeFormat  = "ymd HMS",
                               occasionLength        = 10,
                               day1                  = "survey",
                               includeEffort         = TRUE,
                               timeZone              = "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur"
)

# warning is because camtraps was modified to make up this example
 
# effort is incomplete due to malfunction. Takes both cameras into account (independently)
usage(traps(sdh))
           o1 o2 o3 o4 o5
StationA 18.0 20 19 11  7
StationB  7.5 10 10 10  0
